prompt:
Create a NEW illustration in EXACTLY the visual style of the reference images.
STRICT STYLE: warm editorial illustration, soft painterly line and gentle shading, muted natural palette on a warm cream ground, grounded and human, picture-book register for adults. Warm cream ground, soft dark painterly line, muted blue used sparingly as fill accent.
Subject: a THREE-PANEL horizontal strip, three equal panels in a row separated by clean cream gutters with NO drawn borders or frame lines. ONE consistent world across all three panels: a warm study desk holding a glowing translucent amber laptop, and beside the laptop a thick cream card lying on the desk labeled SKILL. ONE consistent human: a middle-aged Black woman with short natural hair, round glasses, and a mustard cardigan; the SAME woman appears in all three panels and must be recognizably the same person in each. The work happens INSIDE the glowing laptop screen where the small rounded coral-orange holographic Chief of Agents in his grand gold admiral hat appears; he is translucent, casts light not shadow, has rounded mitten stubs never fingers, and stays inside the screen; the woman stays in the warm real world outside it.
PANEL ONE: the woman leans in frowning at the laptop, where inside the screen the Chief of Agents holds up a slightly crooked, visibly incomplete BLANK document page; a soft amber correction line loops from the screen down into the SKILL card on the desk.
PANEL TWO: later at the same desk; the woman sits back with both hands lifted off the keyboard, quietly pleased, while inside the laptop the Chief of Agents presents one clean, straight, finished BLANK document page; the SKILL card beside the laptop now carries several layered soft annotation strokes and glows faintly amber.
PANEL THREE: the woman holds a small new amber correction slip in her fingers, pausing to compare it against the SKILL card, which now shows a short neat stack of three small BLANK case tags along its edge; inside the laptop, two small rounded holographic sub-agents each hold up a clean BLANK document page of a different shape, both intact.
Physical relationships: the laptop screen faces the woman; the SKILL card lies flat on the desk beside the laptop, outside the screen, in the real world; the correction line in panel one travels from the screen DOWN onto the card; the correction slip in panel three is in her hand, not yet on the card.
no comic-book, no cartoon mascot, no flat vector, no neon, no 3D/CGI/Pixar, no photoreal, no anime, no identifiable recurring individual's face or signature clothing. ABSOLUTELY NOT: a denim jacket, a jean jacket, any chest patch, any smiley-face badge, any enamel pin, any embroidered emblem, a white tee under an open jacket.
Render each of these strings EXACTLY, in this placement, lettering only in the cream margins and gutters, never over the artwork:
TITLE BAR centered in the cream margin ABOVE the three panels, in caps: SELF-IMPROVING SKILLS
Caption centered in the cream gutter UNDER panel one, in caps: FIRST RUN FAILS. FOLD IT BACK.
Caption centered in the cream gutter UNDER panel two, in caps: RUNS LATER: IT ONE-SHOTS.
Caption centered in the cream gutter UNDER panel three, in caps: NEW FIX, CHECKED AGAINST THE REST.
FOOTER BAR centered in the cream margin BELOW the panels, in caps: ADOPT ONLY WHAT IMPROVES. IMPROVE WITHOUT DEGRADING.
The ONLY text inside the artwork itself is the single word SKILL on the desk card. Every document page and case tag in the scene is BLANK. There are no signs, posters, labels, or any other lettering anywhere. No other text anywhere.

warm editorial illustration, soft painterly line and gentle shading, muted natural palette on a warm cream ground, grounded and human, picture-book register for adults

Do NOT render it in any of these styles: comic-book, cartoon mascot, flat vector, neon, 3D/CGI/Pixar, photoreal, anime, any identifiable recurring individual's face or signature clothing.

These are LOCKED canonical traits of the subject(s). They are not stylistic suggestions and must survive the render exactly: small-blocky-clay-coral-orange-mascot; translucent-holographic-digital-being; casts-light-not-shadow; grand-ornate-gold-admiral-hat; gold-epaulettes; warm-rounded-dot-eyes-with-tiny-catchlights; two-stubby-legs; short-stubby-nub-arms-end-in-rounded-MITTEN-stubs-NEVER-fingers-hands-tubes-or-bars; never-LIVES-in-the-real-world-soft-crossing-allowed-only-at-delivery-leaning-through-the-screen-body-mostly-inside; never-over-anthropomorphized; never-does-task-work-only-listens-commands-delivers; warm-editorial-register-not-comic; holographic-white-sailor-cap-white-suffused-with-orange-glow; no-gold-anywhere; does-the-hands-on-task-work; carries-work-as-PAPERS-stack-or-messy-fan-or-blueprint-roll-interchangeably-NEVER-a-box-or-parcel; finished-work-always-flows-TO-the-chief-never-directly-to-the-human-or-her-laptop; NEVER-crosses-into-the-real-world-stays-inside-the-digital-space-behind-the-screen; never-the-ONLY-agent-in-a-scene-a-lone-agent-is-always-the-chief; when-shown-mid-journey-a-thin-dotted-glowing-tether-arcs-from-the-sub-agent-to-the-chief.

Identity of record is reference/chief-of-agents/master.png. Derive EVERY new pose from it (pass master as the FIRST input image), one pose per render; NEVER a multi-pose sheet in a single generation (that drifts the body composition). Keep it a SMALL blocky mascot: clay-coral Anthropic orange (~#D97757), two dot-eyes, two stubby legs, a grand ornate GOLD admiral hat + gold epaulettes (this is what makes it the Chief; sub-agents wear plain white sailor caps, no gold). It is a DIGITAL being: translucent, holographic, glowing, casts LIGHT not shadow, lives inside the computer / the agentverse. Do NOT over-anthropomorphize — no big arms, no human proportions (that was the rejected creepy variant). It never does task work; it only listens, commands, and delivers. CROSSING LAW (Gary 2026-07-16, clarified same day): the Chief never LIVES in the real world; it never stands on a real desk, sits in a real chair, or walks a real room as a free-standing body. The one permitted SOFT CROSSING is delivery: leaning through the screen plane, body mostly inside, to hand an artifact to the human or receive one; artifacts themselves may pass through the glass. Delivery may equally be drawn as work materializing on the screen. emerging.png and delivering.png depict the soft-crossing grammar and remain canon references. LONE-AGENT LAW (Gary 2026-07-16): when a scene shows exactly ONE agent, it is the Chief.

Identity of record is reference/sub-agent/master.png, derived from the Chief of Agents v2 master (warm catchlight eyes, short rounded MITTEN nub arms) so the family body is identical. Derive EVERY new pose from the sub-agent master (pass it as the FIRST input image), one pose per render; sheets are composited from locked pose files with an image tool, never generated. States locked: idle (at the ready), working (heads-down at a centered, correctly-proportioned holographic laptop, mitten stubs on the keys), and THREE interchangeable carrying variants (Gary 2026-07-16: keep all, rotate freely): carrying-stack (neat squared pile of glowing papers), carrying-messy (fanned armful, one sheet fluttering loose), carrying-roll (one large blueprint-style rolled bundle). The work it carries is always PAPERS, never a box, parcel, or envelope. DELIVERY DIRECTION (Gary 2026-07-16): finished work always flows UP to the Chief of Agents, never directly to the human or her laptop; only the Chief delivers to the human, and only as work materializing on the screen. Three locked en-route variants (en-route-to-chief-a/b/c, all approved, rotate freely) show the sub-agent mid-stride carrying its papers toward the waiting Chief with a thin DOTTED glowing tether arcing between them; use that dotted-tether grammar whenever a scene shows work in transit. The moment of transfer is locked as handoff-to-chief.png (Gary picked it 2026-07-16): a three-quarter view, the sub-agent tipping its fanned papers forward off its short mitten stubs while the Chief catches the fan with both short mitten stubs, both arms staying stubby, the Chief only very slightly taller. The cap is mostly white but HOLOGRAPHIC: translucent glowing white suffused with warm orange light and a faint grid, part of the same digital being, never solid real-world cloth. Keep it a DIGITAL being: translucent, holographic, glowing, casts light not shadow. The moment any gold appears it has become the Chief; that is the defect to guard against. CROSSING LAW (Gary 2026-07-16): the sub-agent never crosses into the real world at all, not even the soft delivery crossing the Chief is allowed; it never stands on a real desk or appears in the room. It exists only inside the glowing digital space. LONE-AGENT LAW (Gary 2026-07-16): a sub-agent never appears as the only agent in a scene; if a scene shows exactly ONE agent, that agent is the Chief of Agents. Sub-agents appear only in the Chief's command structure.
